episode.title: What If the Moon Vanished? Earth's Tides COLLAPSE

synopsis: The sudden vanishing of the Moon disrupts Earth's ocean tides and long-term orbital stability, sending planetary climate into turmoil.
narration: If the Moon suddenly vanished, Earth's oceanic tides would instantly collapse to a fraction of their strength. Over millions of years, without lunar stabilization, Earth's axial tilt would wobble violently, plunging global climates into utter atmospheric chaos.

shots.prompt: Photoreal vertical shot of Earth in deep space with the Moon brightly visible in foreground orbit, dynamic light casting sharp lunar craters against blue oceans.
The Moon instantly dissolves into faint cosmic dust and vanishes, causing ocean tidal bulges on Earth below to visibly shrink and flatten as camera slowly pans down.
Earth wobbling unsteadily on its tilted axis against a dark background of stars, cloud layers swirling wildly, as camera glides smoothly back into the original orbital framing.

music: An eerie cinematic synth drone backed by a steady rhythmic pulse, swelling dramatically with ominous low orchestral strings as Earth destabilizes on its axis in deep space, maintaining high cosmic tension before cutting abruptly mid-bar on a resonant pulsing bass note for an infinite loop.
